Job Title: Enterprise Shared Services Tooling Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Public Trust 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 

 The Enterprise Service Tooling Developer designs, builds, tests, and maintains software features and systems with increasing independence. Building on foundational experience, this role owns medium-complexity components end to end, contributes to architectural and design discussions. The ideal candidate writes clean, maintainable code, collaborates effectively across functions, and continuously improves both their technical skills and the team's engineering practices.

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Software Development / Tooling integration 
 Design, develop, and deliver features and enhancements for web, mobile, backend, or distributed systems, as assigned.
 Write clean, well-structured, testable, and maintainable code that follows team standards and best practices.
 Own medium-complexity features or components from requirements through deployment and post-release support.
 Break down ambiguous requirements into well-scoped technical tasks and estimate effort with reasonable accuracy.
 
 Design and Architecture 
 Participate in system design discussions and propose solutions for scalability, reliability, performance, and security.
 Create and review technical design documents for features within your area of ownership.
 Evaluate tradeoffs among technologies, frameworks, and approaches, and document the rationale behind decisions.
 
 Quality and Testing 
 Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code correctness and prevent regressions.
 Conduct thorough code reviews that provide constructive, specific, and actionable feedback.
 Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex defects in your own code and in components you maintain.
 
 Operations and Reliability 
 Participate in on-call rotations and respond to production incidents.
 Monitor application health using logs, metrics, and alerts; proactively address performance bottlenecks.
 Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and infrastructure-as-code where applicable.
 
 Collaboration and Communication 
 Work closely with product managers, designers, QA, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver user value.
 Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Provide accurate status updates and surface risks, blockers, and scope changes early.
 Contribute to team documentation, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
 Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical discussions.
 Continuously expand your knowledge of tools, languages, and industry trends.
 
 Core Competencies 
 Ownership: Takes responsibility for outcomes and follows work through to completion.
 Technical Depth: Applies sound engineering judgment and deepens expertise in core technologies.
 Collaboration: Builds trust and works constructively with diverse teams.
 Adaptability: Learns quickly and adjusts to changing priorities and technologies.
 Continuous Improvement: Seeks feedback and actively improves code quality, processes, and skills.
 
 Required Qualifications: 

 Must be a U.S. Citizen
 Public Trust required
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 2–4 years of professional software development experience.
 Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Java, Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go).
 Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented or functional design principles.
 Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases.
 Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows.
 Familiarity with RESTful APIs and web service design.
 Working knowledge of testing frameworks and test-driven or behavior-driven development practices.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on well-defined projects.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
 Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
 Experience with microservices architecture, message queues, or event-driven systems.
 Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
 Understanding of security best practices, including OWASP top 10 and secure coding.
 Experience mentoring or onboarding other engineers.
 Contributions to open-source projects.
 


 
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$63,300-$129,700 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
